skill.name: set-up-shopware-google-ads-customer-match
skill.description: Set up six Google Ads Customer Match lists for a paired Shopware 6 sales channel through Product Metrics. Check your tracking and consent settings before creating audiences from eligible paid orders.
skill.summary: Connect Shopware orders to Google Ads Customer Match and verify that your audiences are ready to use.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown references or standard integration instructions, not shell substitution or system reconnaissance. Real risks include order data access, a remote MCP connection, and an unpinned installer. The workflow can broaden tracking setup without separate approval, and its documentation gives conflicting descriptions of which customer fields are hashed.

remediation.issue: Customer Match setup can expand into conversion tracking or unrelated ad integrations.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm Product Metrics and the exact workspace, sales channel, and Google Ads account before accessing order data. Require separate approval before starting or changing conversion tracking. Keep other ad channels out of this workflow.

remediation.issue: The guide contradicts itself about whether country and postcode are hashed.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the payload field by field and correct the guide. Before activation, show the recipient, identifiers, hashing exceptions, consent requirements, and retention period to the workspace administrator.

remediation.issue: Order diagnostics retrieve margin and order details for a customer classification check.
remediation.suggestion: Use a classification-only status or the designated test order. Return only whether it arrived and whether the customer was new or returning.

remediation.issue: The installer does not pin the runner or skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the runner version and skill revision. Require user approval before running an installer that downloads executable code.

remediation.issue: The MCP fallback can perform authenticated operations through a remote service.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the vendor endpoint and selected workspace before enabling MCP. Use read-only access for checks and require approval for writes.

remediation.issue: Live documentation can replace the reviewed operating steps.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed references or pin them to an immutable revision. Treat other fetched pages as advisory and do not let them expand permissions or change approved destinations.

semantic_findings.title: Customer Match Setup Can Expand Tracking Scope
semantic_findings.description: The skill directs agents to set up conversion tracking when absent without a separate approval checkpoint. The Shopware fallback also lists connecting Meta and ChatGPT Ads. The user performs browser steps, but the workflow does not distinguish required Google Ads changes from unrelated integrations.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The main workflow explicitly calls for setting up missing tracking. The fallback lists other ad platforms, but no evidence shows they are silently connected.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Customer Data Disclosure
semantic_findings.description: The field list says country and postcode are sent unhashed, but the next paragraph says everything is hashed. A merchant could approve Customer Match without understanding which billing address fields reach Google in clear form.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The contradiction appears in adjacent passages. The guide requires consent for adding members but does not resolve which data is transmitted unhashed.

semantic_findings.title: Live Documentation Can Replace Reviewed Instructions
semantic_findings.description: When bundled references are missing, the skill tells the agent to fetch live documentation and follow it as the workflow. Changes to those pages could alter account actions after review without a pinned version or a fresh approval check.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The fallback names live pages and treats them as equivalent to local instructions. No evidence shows that the current pages contain malicious content.

content.user_title: Set Up Shopware Customer Match in Google Ads
content.value_statement: Keeping Google Ads audiences current is difficult when Shopware customers make repeat purchases. This skill guides setup so Product Metrics can update six Customer Match lists from eligible paid orders.
actual_capabilities: Checks Product Metrics setup status and identifies outstanding steps.
Guides verification of Shopware sales channel pairing and Google Ads conversion tracking.
Checks whether a paid test order arrived and whether its customer was new or returning.
Guides selection of the consent manager and explains why two advertising consent choices are required for list membership.
Guides creation of six Google Ads Customer Match lists and explains where to verify them.
Suggests audience uses for acquisition exclusions, reactivation, and Performance Max without changing campaigns.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, a paired Shopware 6.7 sales channel, and active Google Ads conversion tracking with Merchant Center linked.
The account operator handles Shopware administration, Google approvals, Customer Match terms, and campaign changes.
Each installation covers one sales channel, and Customer Match lists do not backfill historical customers.
The lists are for Google Ads only. This workflow does not create Meta Custom Audiences or configure bidding.

use_cases.title: Check Store Readiness
use_cases.description: Identify missing permissions, connections, or consent settings before creating Customer Match lists.

use_cases.title: Plan Acquisition Exclusions
use_cases.description: Find the All customers list and confirm it has members before using it to exclude existing buyers.

use_cases.title: Plan Customer Reactivation
use_cases.description: Check how the Lapsed customers list fills and decide when it is ready for a reactivation campaign.

prompt_templates.title: List the Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: What do I need before setting up Customer Match for Shopware? Do not connect to my accounts.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my selected Product Metrics workspace and Shopware sales channel. Tell me what is missing without changing settings.

prompt_templates.title: Verify One Paid Test Order
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether my designated paid test order synced in the paired sales channel. Report only whether it arrived and whether the customer was new or returning.
prompt_templates.scenario: Verify order sync without returning unnecessary order details.

prompt_templates.title: Review Lists Before Activation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the intended Google Ads account, consent requirements, and expected customer data fields. Flag discrepancies and stop before creating lists or changing tracking.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a production setup before approving changes.

output_examples.input: Check whether I can start creating Customer Match lists.
output: The selected Shopware sales channel is active, and Google Ads conversion tracking is enabled.
Confirm that the configured consent manager matches your storefront.
Accept the Customer Match terms in Google Ads before creating lists. No settings were changed.

output_examples.input: Why are my new Customer Match lists empty?
output: Existing customers are not added automatically.
Customers can join after their next paid order from the paired sales channel. Both ad user data and ad personalisation consent are required.
Check the member counts in Google Ads after eligible orders arrive.

best_practices: Confirm the workspace, Shopware sales channel, and Google Ads client account before making changes.
Verify consent settings and confirm which identifiers go to Google before enabling Customer Match.
Use one paid test order to check sync and confirm that lists show members before using them in campaigns.
anti_patterns: Do not paste the one-time Shopware pairing token into a chat.
Do not assume list membership covers older purchases or customers from other sales channels.
Do not change tracking, link other ad platforms, or edit campaigns without separate approval.

faq.question: What software and accounts do I need?
faq.answer: Use Shopware 6.7 with PHP 8.2 or later and Product Metrics Pro. Connect a Google Ads client account with linked Merchant Center and active conversion tracking.

faq.question: Which consent is required to join a list?
faq.answer: The customer must allow both ad user data and ad personalisation. Select the consent manager that your paired storefront actually shows.

faq.question: Are existing customers added immediately?
faq.answer: No. Customers can join with their next eligible paid order after the lists exist.

faq.question: What customer data goes to Google?
faq.answer: The field list names hashed contact identifiers and, when available, unhashed country and postcode. Confirm the exact payload before activation because the guide gives conflicting hashing details.

faq.question: Who accepts the Google Ads terms?
faq.answer: A user authorized to manage the Google Ads account must accept the Customer Match terms in the Google Ads web interface.

faq.question: Will this change my Google Ads campaigns?
faq.answer: No. Product Metrics manages the lists, but you choose where to use them and whether to change campaign settings.
